title: Three Little Kittens: How Mittens Keep Your Fingers Warm!

lines.text: Three little kittens, they lost their mittens, and they began to cry!
lines.caps: Three little *KITTENS, | they lost their *MITTENS, | and they began to *CRY!

lines.text: Oh mother dear, our paws are freezing cold outside!
lines.caps: Oh mother *DEAR, | our paws are *FREEZING | cold *OUTSIDE!

lines.text: Put on your mittens! But did you know mittens don't actually make any heat?
lines.caps: Put on your *MITTENS! | But did you know mittens *DON'T | actually make any *HEAT?

lines.text: Your own body makes warm heat like a little internal furnace!
lines.caps: Your own body *MAKES | warm heat like a *LITTLE | internal *FURNACE!

lines.text: Fluffy wool fibers trap millions of microscopic pockets of still air!
lines.caps: Fluffy wool fibers *TRAP | millions of microscopic *POCKETS | of still *AIR!

lines.text: Trapped air is a super insulator that stops cold air from stealing your warmth!
lines.caps: Trapped air is a super *INSULATOR | that stops cold air from *STEALING | your *WARMTH!

lines.text: And inside mittens, your fingers huddle together to share their heat!
lines.caps: And inside *MITTENS, | your fingers huddle *TOGETHER | to share their *HEAT!

lines.text: Now you know the cozy physics behind Three Little Kittens and their mittens!
lines.caps: Now you *KNOW | the cozy *PHYSICS | behind Three Little *KITTENS | and their mittens!
